action: Call an emergency town council session specifically on the RoboRide Phase 2 announcement and its economic implications for Millfield. Frame the agenda as: (1) threat assessment — what the two-month deployment timeline means for transportation-adjacent employment and consumer spending; (2) immediate response options — workforce retraining fund, emergency small business stabilization grant program, zoning and licensing considerations for robotaxi operations; (3) a mandate to form a standing Economic Transition Task Force with quarterly reporting. Prepare a short briefing document so council members arrive informed rather than reactive. Be clear in public materials: this is not alarmism, this is governance.
